verses.pali: Aṅguttara Nikāya 11.4
verses.english: Numbered Discourses 11.4

verses.pali: 1. Nissayavagga
verses.english: 1. Dependence

verses.pali: Dutiyaupanisāsutta
verses.english: Vital Conditions (2nd)

verses.pali: Tatra kho āyasmā sāriputto bhikkhū āmantesi:
verses.english: There Venerable Sāriputta addressed the mendicants:

verses.pali: “āvuso bhikkhave”ti.
verses.english: “Reverends, mendicants!”

verses.pali: “Āvuso”ti kho te bhikkhū āyasmato sāriputtassa paccassosuṁ.
verses.english: “Reverend,” they replied.

verses.pali: Āyasmā sāriputto etadavoca:
verses.english: Sāriputta said this:

verses.pali: “Dussīlassa, āvuso, sīlavipannassa hatūpaniso hoti avippaṭisāro,
verses.english: “An unethical person, who lacks ethics, has destroyed a vital condition for not having regrets.

verses.pali: avippaṭisāre asati avippaṭisāravipannassa hatūpanisaṁ hoti pāmojjaṁ,
verses.english: When there are regrets, one who has regrets has destroyed a vital condition for joy.

verses.pali: pāmojje asati pāmojjavipannassa hatūpanisā hoti pīti,
verses.english: When there is no joy, one who lacks joy has destroyed a vital condition for rapture.

verses.pali: pītiyā asati pītivipannassa hatūpanisā hoti passaddhi,
verses.english: When there is no rapture, one who lacks rapture has destroyed a vital condition for tranquility.

verses.pali: passaddhiyā asati passaddhivipannassa hatūpanisaṁ hoti sukhaṁ,
verses.english: When there is no tranquility, one who lacks tranquility has destroyed a vital condition for bliss.

verses.pali: sukhe asati sukhavipannassa hatūpaniso hoti sammāsamādhi,
verses.english: When there is no bliss, one who lacks bliss has destroyed a vital condition for right immersion.

verses.pali: sammāsamādhimhi asati sammāsamādhivipannassa hatūpanisaṁ hoti yathābhūtañāṇadassanaṁ,
verses.english: When there is no right immersion, one who lacks right immersion has destroyed a vital condition for true knowledge and vision.

verses.pali: yathābhūtañāṇadassane asati yathābhūtañāṇadassanavipannassa hatūpanisā hoti nibbidā,
verses.english: When there is no true knowledge and vision, one who lacks true knowledge and vision has destroyed a vital condition for disillusionment.

verses.pali: nibbidāya asati nibbidāvipannassa hatūpaniso hoti virāgo,
verses.english: When there is no disillusionment, one who lacks disillusionment has destroyed a vital condition for dispassion.

verses.pali: virāge asati virāgavipannassa hatūpanisaṁ hoti vimuttiñāṇadassanaṁ.
verses.english: When there is no dispassion, one who lacks dispassion has destroyed a vital condition for knowledge and vision of freedom.

verses.pali: Seyyathāpi, āvuso, rukkho sākhāpalāsavipanno. Tassa papaṭikāpi na pāripūriṁ gacchati, tacopi … pheggupi … sāropi na pāripūriṁ gacchati.
verses.english: Suppose there was a tree that lacked branches and foliage. Its shoots, bark, softwood, and heartwood would not grow to fullness.

verses.pali: Evamevaṁ kho, āvuso, dussīlassa sīlavipannassa hatūpaniso hoti avippaṭisāro,
verses.english: In the same way, an unethical person, who lacks ethics, has destroyed a vital condition for having no regrets.

verses.pali: avippaṭisāre asati avippaṭisāravipannassa hatūpanisaṁ hoti pāmojjaṁ …pe…
verses.english: When there are regrets, one who has regrets has destroyed a vital condition for joy. …

verses.pali: vimuttiñāṇadassanaṁ.
verses.english: When there is dispassion, one who lacks dispassion has destroyed a vital condition for knowledge and vision of freedom.

verses.pali: Sīlavato, āvuso, sīlasampannassa upanisasampanno hoti avippaṭisāro,
verses.english: An ethical person, who has fulfilled ethics, has fulfilled a vital condition for not having regrets.

verses.pali: avippaṭisāre sati avippaṭisārasampannassa upanisasampannaṁ hoti pāmojjaṁ,
verses.english: When there are no regrets, one who has no regrets has fulfilled a vital condition for joy.

verses.pali: pāmojje sati pāmojjasampannassa upanisasampannā hoti pīti,
verses.english: When there is joy, one who has fulfilled joy has fulfilled a vital condition for rapture.

verses.pali: pītiyā sati pītisampannassa upanisasampannā hoti passaddhi,
verses.english: When there is rapture, one who has fulfilled rapture has fulfilled a vital condition for tranquility.

verses.pali: passaddhiyā sati passaddhisampannassa upanisasampannaṁ hoti sukhaṁ,
verses.english: When there is tranquility, one who has fulfilled tranquility has fulfilled a vital condition for bliss.

verses.pali: sukhe sati sukhasampannassa upanisasampanno hoti sammāsamādhi,
verses.english: When there is bliss, one who has fulfilled bliss has fulfilled a vital condition for right immersion.

verses.pali: sammāsamādhimhi sati sammāsamādhisampannassa upanisasampannaṁ hoti yathābhūtañāṇadassanaṁ,
verses.english: When there is right immersion, one who has fulfilled right immersion has fulfilled a vital condition for true knowledge and vision.

verses.pali: yathābhūtañāṇadassane sati yathābhūtañāṇadassanasampannassa upanisasampannā hoti nibbidā,
verses.english: When there is true knowledge and vision, one who has fulfilled true knowledge and vision has fulfilled a vital condition for disillusionment.

verses.pali: nibbidāya sati nibbidāsampannassa upanisasampanno hoti virāgo,
verses.english: When there is disillusionment, one who has fulfilled disillusionment has fulfilled a vital condition for dispassion.

verses.pali: virāge sati virāgasampannassa upanisasampannaṁ hoti vimuttiñāṇadassanaṁ.
verses.english: When there is dispassion, one who has fulfilled dispassion has fulfilled a vital condition for knowledge and vision of freedom.

verses.pali: Seyyathāpi, āvuso, rukkho sākhāpalāsasampanno. Tassa papaṭikāpi pāripūriṁ gacchati, tacopi … pheggupi … sāropi pāripūriṁ gacchati.
verses.english: Suppose there was a tree that was complete with branches and foliage. Its shoots, bark, softwood, and heartwood would grow to fullness.

verses.pali: Evamevaṁ kho, āvuso, sīlavato sīlasampannassa upanisasampanno hoti avippaṭisāro,
verses.english: In the same way, an ethical person, who has fulfilled ethics, has fulfilled a vital condition for not having regrets.

verses.pali: avippaṭisāre sati avippaṭisārasampannassa upanisasampannaṁ hoti pāmojjaṁ …pe…
verses.english: When there are no regrets, one who has no regrets has fulfilled a vital condition for joy. …

verses.pali: vimuttiñāṇadassanan”ti. …pe…
verses.english: When there is dispassion, one who has fulfilled dispassion has fulfilled a vital condition for knowledge and vision of freedom.”

verses.pali: Catutthaṁ.
